product.title: Deluxe Sunset & Day Sail Small Group
product.description: Experience the beauty of the San Diego coastline on a peaceful sunset sailing tour, avoiding the crowds at popular viewing spots. Relax aboard your vessel as you take in stunning sunset views, along with possible sightings of dolphins, vibrant seabirds, and sea lions. Along the way, enjoy scenic views of the Coronado Bridge, Point Loma, and San Diego Bay.
highlights: Perfect way to get San Diego sunset shots
Small-group experience, capped at six travelers
Enjoy onboard drinks—including soft and alcoholic drinks
Learn about local marine life from your crew
